title: Guest saw no UFO trace among Stony Brook physicists
place_text: Stony Brook University, Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics

plain: From 2004 to 2008, while he was at Stony Brook University, Maaneli Derakhshani says he saw no sign of any interest in UFOs among the leading theoretical physicists and mathematicians there. He tells Michels he dealt closely with nearly all the top professors at the Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics and in the math department, and ran the math club for a couple of years, yet "never came across any hint or trace" of it. The point comes up while they are talking about the mathematician Jim Simons, and it suggests that, at least as far as he could see, that circle had no hidden link to the subject.
